typography.heading: Satoshi Bold
typography.instructions: In `/app/frontend/src/index.css`, replace Montserrat and Calibri font imports and rules with Satoshi. Add to `body` and `.font-sans` the fallback `'Satoshi', sans-serif`. Update `.font-display` to use Satoshi.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: In `/app/frontend/src/index.css`, update the `:root` CSS variables. Set `--navy: #0F172A;`, `--teal: #22C55E;`, `--coral: #FBBF24;`. Also update Tailwind config or CSS variables for Shadcn to match the new palette. Set primary to `#22C55E`.

sidebar.text: Labels 'MASSE SALARIALE' and 'COMPTABILITÉ' in muted uppercase. Nav items have icon + title + subtitle.
sidebar.active_state: Mint background (`bg-[#A7F3DD]`/30 or similar soft mint) with Meelora Green icon (`text-[#22C55E]`) and green label.
sidebar.footer: Tagline 'Votre entreprise, clairement.' with a small plant/growth-chart SVG illustration. User profile block (avatar initial + name + ADMIN badge + email + chevron).

header.elements: Breadcrumb 'Masse salariale › Salaires & Budget', big Satoshi title, subtitle.
header.right_side: Green 'Budget actif' pill (`bg-[#22C55E]/10 text-[#22C55E]`), calendar/year selector '2026', '+ Année' button, top-right circular icon buttons (help, bell, gear).

kpi_cards.styling: White background, soft rounded (`rounded-2xl`), subtle border/shadow.
kpi_cards.content: Pastel colored icon chip per card (salaire=slate, vacances=amber, primes=amber, avantages=violet/mint, budget total=green), large navy value (`text-[#0F172A]`).

footer.content: '© 2026 Meelora inc. Tous droits réservés.' + links (Confidentialité, Conditions d'utilisation, Aide) + small meelora logo bottom-left.

components.tabs: Active tab should have a green underline (`border-b-2 border-[#22C55E] text-[#22C55E]`).
components.tables: Green positive amounts (`text-[#22C55E]`), green pagination active page, '25 / page' selector. Amounts formatting québécois MUST remain unchanged.
components.charts: Update Recharts to use the 4-color Meelora palette: `#0F172A`, `#22C55E`, `#A7F3DD`, `#FBBF24`. Update `<Bar>`, `<Line>`, and `<Pie>` colors respectively.

visual enhancers.shadows: Subtle, soft shadows for KPI cards (`box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05)`).
visual enhancers.borders: Soft gray borders (`border-[#F3F4F6]`) for card separation.
visual enhancers.radius: Use `rounded-xl` or `rounded-2xl` for main cards and widgets to align with the modern mockup.

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace all 'Budget Salaires Pro' / 'ACCS' text with 'meelora'.
Update `/app/frontend/src/index.css` to import Satoshi font and replace old font variables.
Map old colors to new Meelora colors in CSS variables.
Redesign the Sidebar: Remove dark navy theme, implement light theme with the Meelora logo (green M + amber dot) at top-left. Apply the Mint/Green active state styling.
Update Header: Build out the breadcrumb, title layout, and the right-side controls.
Update KPI Cards: Refine styling for pastel icon chips and typography.
DO NOT break existing application logic, routes, or Shadcn behavior. Restyle only.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
